###################################################
# LOOSE FILE MOVE FUNCTION APP
#
# One Windows Function App per environment/region
# stack, shared by all pods.
#
# AzureRM manages the supporting infrastructure.
# AzAPI manages the Function App itself because
# AzureRM does not currently expose
# autoGeneratedDomainNameLabelScope.
###################################################


###################################################
# APP SERVICE PLAN (WINDOWS, DEDICATED)
###################################################

resource "azurerm_service_plan" "loose_file_move" {
  count = var.loose_file_move_enabled ? 1 : 0

  name                = local.loose_file_move_names.service_plan
  resource_group_name = azurerm_resource_group.mft_rg.name
  location            = var.location

  os_type  = "Windows"
  sku_name = var.function_service_plan_sku

  tags = merge(local.base_tags, {})
}


###################################################
# RUNTIME STORAGE ACCOUNT (FUNCTIONS HOST)
###################################################

resource "azurerm_storage_account" "loose_file_move_runtime" {
  count = var.loose_file_move_enabled ? 1 : 0

  name                = local.loose_file_move_names.storage_account
  resource_group_name = azurerm_resource_group.mft_rg.name
  location            = var.location

  account_tier             = "Standard"
  account_replication_type = "LRS"
  account_kind             = "StorageV2"

  min_tls_version                 = "TLS1_2"
  shared_access_key_enabled       = false
  allow_nested_items_to_be_public = false
  public_network_access           = "Enabled"

  tags = merge(local.base_tags, {})
}


###################################################
# RUNTIME STORAGE NETWORK RULES
###################################################

resource "azurerm_storage_account_network_rules" "loose_file_move_runtime" {
  count = var.loose_file_move_enabled ? 1 : 0

  storage_account_id = azurerm_storage_account.loose_file_move_runtime[0].id

  default_action = "Deny"
  bypass         = ["AzureServices"]

  ip_rules = var.function_runtime_storage_allowed_ip_rules
}


###################################################
# RUNTIME STORAGE PRIVATE ENDPOINTS
###################################################

resource "azurerm_private_endpoint" "loose_file_move_runtime" {
  for_each = var.loose_file_move_enabled ? toset([
    "blob",
    "queue",
    "table",
  ]) : toset([])

  name                = "${azurerm_storage_account.loose_file_move_runtime[0].name}-${each.key}-pe"
  resource_group_name = azurerm_resource_group.mft_rg.name
  location            = var.location
  subnet_id           = data.azurerm_subnet.mft.id

  private_service_connection {
    name = "${azurerm_storage_account.loose_file_move_runtime[0].name}-${each.key}-psc"

    private_connection_resource_id = azurerm_storage_account.loose_file_move_runtime[0].id
    subresource_names              = [each.key]
    is_manual_connection           = false
  }

  dynamic "private_dns_zone_group" {
    for_each = local.loose_file_move_runtime_dns_zone_ids[each.key] != null ? [1] : []

    content {
      name = "default"

      private_dns_zone_ids = [
        local.loose_file_move_runtime_dns_zone_ids[each.key]
      ]
    }
  }

  tags = merge(local.base_tags, {})
}

# APPLICATION INSIGHTS

###################################################
# FUNCTION APP
#
# AzAPI is used specifically because
# azurerm_windows_function_app does not currently
# expose autoGeneratedDomainNameLabelScope.
###################################################

resource "azapi_resource" "loose_file_move" {
  count = var.loose_file_move_enabled ? 1 : 0

  type      = "Microsoft.Web/sites@2025-03-01"
  name      = local.loose_file_move_names.function_app
  parent_id = azurerm_resource_group.mft_rg.id
  location  = var.location

  identity {
    type = "SystemAssigned, UserAssigned"

    identity_ids = [
      data.azurerm_user_assigned_identity.loose_file_move[0].id
    ]
  }

  body = {
    kind = "functionapp"

    properties = {
      #################################################
      # Hosting
      #################################################

      serverFarmId = azurerm_service_plan.loose_file_move[0].id

      # Windows App Service / Functions plan.
      reserved = false

      #################################################
      # SECURE UNIQUE DEFAULT HOSTNAME
      #
      # Example result:
      #
      # myfunc-a3dze9hpc5cucybj.eastus-01.azurewebsites.net
      #
      # TenantReuse provides a stable uniqueness scope
      # associated with this Entra tenant.
      #################################################

      autoGeneratedDomainNameLabelScope = "TenantReuse"

      #################################################
      # Public endpoint
      #################################################

      httpsOnly = true

      # Event Grid reaches the Function App through
      # the public endpoint. Access restrictions below
      # limit who may actually reach it.
      publicNetworkAccess = "Enabled"

      #################################################
      # VNet integration
      #
      # Uncomment when the integration subnet is ready.
      #################################################

      # virtualNetworkSubnetId = data.azurerm_subnet.function_integration_subnet.id

      #################################################
      # Site configuration
      #################################################

      siteConfig = {
        alwaysOn = true

        # Route outbound traffic through VNet integration
        # when a VNet integration subnet is configured.
        vnetRouteAllEnabled = true

        minTlsVersion = "1.2"
        ftpsState     = "Disabled"

        #################################################
        # .NET runtime
        #
        # Existing AzureRM dotnet_version values such as
        # "v8.0" map directly to netFrameworkVersion.
        #################################################

        netFrameworkVersion = var.function_dotnet_version

        #################################################
        # Main site access restrictions
        #################################################

        ipSecurityRestrictionsDefaultAction = "Deny"

        ipSecurityRestrictions = [
          {
            name      = "AllowEventGrid"
            priority  = 100
            action    = "Allow"

            # ARM representation of an Azure service-tag
            # access restriction.
            tag       = "ServiceTag"
            ipAddress = "AzureEventGrid"
          }
        ]

        #################################################
        # SCM / Kudu access restrictions
        #################################################

        scmIpSecurityRestrictionsUseMain      = false
        scmIpSecurityRestrictionsDefaultAction = "Deny"

        scmIpSecurityRestrictions = [
          for idx, ip_range in var.function_scm_allowed_ip_ranges : {
            name      = "AllowDeploy${idx}"
            ipAddress = ip_range
            priority  = 100 + idx
            action    = "Allow"
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  }

  tags = merge(local.base_tags, {})

  #################################################
  # Export properties needed by other resources.
  #################################################

  response_export_values = [
    "identity.principalId",
    "properties.defaultHostName",
  ]

  depends_on = [
    azurerm_private_endpoint.loose_file_move_runtime,
    azurerm_storage_account_network_rules.loose_file_move_runtime,
  ]
}


###################################################
# FUNCTION APP SETTINGS
#
# App settings are maintained as the ARM
# sites/config child resource rather than embedded
# in Microsoft.Web/sites.
###################################################

resource "azapi_resource" "loose_file_move_appsettings" {
  count = var.loose_file_move_enabled ? 1 : 0

  type      = "Microsoft.Web/sites/config@2025-03-01"
  name      = "appsettings"
  parent_id = azapi_resource.loose_file_move[0].id

  body = {
    properties = {
      #################################################
      # Azure Functions runtime
      #################################################

      FUNCTIONS_EXTENSION_VERSION = "~4"

      FUNCTIONS_WORKER_RUNTIME = (
        var.function_use_isolated_runtime
        ? "dotnet-isolated"
        : "dotnet"
      )

      #################################################
      # Package deployment
      #################################################

      WEBSITE_RUN_FROM_PACKAGE = "1"

      #################################################
      # AzureWebJobsStorage using managed identity
      #
      # No storage account key or connection string is
      # required.
      #
      # With no __clientId specified, Functions uses the
      # Function App's system-assigned managed identity.
      #################################################

      AzureWebJobsStorage__accountName = (
        azurerm_storage_account.loose_file_move_runtime[0].name
      )

      AzureWebJobsStorage__credential = "managedidentity"

      #################################################
      # If you later decide that AzureWebJobsStorage
      # should use the attached UAMI instead, add:
      #
      # AzureWebJobsStorage__clientId =
      #   data.azurerm_user_assigned_identity.loose_file_move[0].client_id
      #################################################

      #################################################
      # Application Insights - currently disabled
      #################################################

      # APPLICATIONINSIGHTS_CONNECTION_STRING = (
      #   azurerm_application_insights.loose_file_move[0].connection_string
      # )
    }
  }
}


###################################################
# DISABLE FTP BASIC AUTHENTICATION
#
# Equivalent of:
#
# ftp_publish_basic_authentication_enabled = false
###################################################

resource "azapi_resource" "loose_file_move_ftp_policy" {
  count = var.loose_file_move_enabled ? 1 : 0

  type = (
    "Microsoft.Web/sites/basicPublishingCredentialsPolicies@2025-03-01"
  )

  name      = "ftp"
  parent_id = azapi_resource.loose_file_move[0].id

  body = {
    properties = {
      allow = false
    }
  }
}


###################################################
# DISABLE SCM / WEBDEPLOY BASIC AUTHENTICATION
#
# Equivalent of:
#
# webdeploy_publish_basic_authentication_enabled = false
###################################################

resource "azapi_resource" "loose_file_move_scm_policy" {
  count = var.loose_file_move_enabled ? 1 : 0

  type = (
    "Microsoft.Web/sites/basicPublishingCredentialsPolicies@2025-03-01"
  )

  name      = "scm"
  parent_id = azapi_resource.loose_file_move[0].id

  body = {
    properties = {
      allow = false
    }
  }
}


###################################################
# RBAC - FUNCTION APP SYSTEM-ASSIGNED IDENTITY
###################################################

# Functions host storage:
# leases, host keys, internal queues and tables.
#
# This intentionally uses the system-assigned
# identity of the newly created Function App.

resource "azurerm_role_assignment" "loose_file_move_runtime_storage" {
  for_each = var.loose_file_move_enabled ? toset([
    "Storage Blob Data Owner",
    "Storage Queue Data Contributor",
    "Storage Table Data Contributor",
  ]) : toset([])

  scope = azurerm_storage_account.loose_file_move_runtime[0].id

  role_definition_name = each.key

  principal_id = (
    azapi_resource.loose_file_move[0].output.identity.principalId
  )
}


###################################################
# RBAC - DEPLOYERS
###################################################

# Allows designated deployer identities to perform
# remote code deployment against the Function App.

resource "azurerm_role_assignment" "loose_file_move_deployers" {
  for_each = (
    var.loose_file_move_enabled
    ? toset(var.function_deployer_object_ids)
    : toset([])
  )

  scope = azapi_resource.loose_file_move[0].id

  role_definition_name = "Website Contributor"
  principal_id         = each.value
}
